posts.title: Tahoe Rim Trail thru-hike: a trail journal
posts.description: This journal was transcribed from handwritten notebook pages. I lightly edited it for coherence after the trip, but left many places with suboptimal writing quality to more accurately represent my mental state while on the trip. It was inspired by Andrew Kelley’s JMT journal . Foreword I’m writing this on the Zephyr to the Bay, coming back from my trip. I decided to take a week off to go on a back

posts.title: Creating Interpretable Latent Spaces with Gradient Routing
posts.description: Over the past few months, I helped develop Gradient Routing, a non loss-based method to shape the internals of neural networks.
